newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar firms as August, October dominate.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar firms as August, October dominate.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was firmer with August and October dominating as players squared positions ahead of the front month's expiry, traders said.
Much of the activity was in switches, traders said.

By 1537 GMT, 1,429 of a total 3,250 lots done were on active August, which last traded $1.30 higher at $320.50. Much of the rest of the volume, 1,204 lots, was on October, which last traded 60 cents higher at $314.80 as the August/October spread again widened.
The market was helped by some trade buying, one trader said. But its effect was limited in a market lacking strong direction.
